name: Oncogenic membrane-bound RTK fusions and ALK/LTK kinases
rationale: All members are constitutive oncogenic RTK signaling, specifically membrane-tethered FGFR/PDGFR fusions plus ALK/LTK, which the confusables lack in favour of amplification, point mutants or cytosolic fusions.

name: Myeloid lineage commitment under RUNX transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, megakaryocyte, erythroid, mast cell and monocyte differentiation plus RUNX1/2/3 target programmes, unlike confusables centred on HSC maintenance or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and anti-inflammatory macrophage responses
rationale: Members share phagocyte NADPH oxidase/superoxide control and pathogen-triggered anti-inflammatory macrophage signaling (CD163, IL10, ADORA2B), which the neutrophil degranulation and dendritic-cell confusables lack.

qualifier: cadherin, desmosome and hemidesmosome with epithelial polarity
name: Cadherin and desmosomal junction assembly with epithelial polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens junction, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, CDH1 trafficking/degradation and apical-basal polarity, beyond the confusables' regulation of cadherin adhesion and EMT.

name: Renal tubular organic ion, urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion/cation, urate and cystine transport and their renal disorders, whereas confusables focus on neutral amino acid and peptide transport.

name: Cholesterol sensing and SREBP feedback on biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing, SREBP signaling and regulation of cholesterol synthesis and uptake, distinct from the confusables' LXR-driven efflux and lipoprotein clearance.

qualifier: capping and suppression of telomeric recombination
name: Telomere capping and control of telomeric recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging, protection from NHEJ and recombination/telomerase restraint, lacking the confusables' C-strand synthesis and telomerase extension.

name: Endothelial nitric oxide signaling in vascular tone
rationale: Members combine eNOS activation, trafficking and NO-cGMP signaling with vasoconstriction/relaxation and blood pressure control, whereas confusables lack eNOS and emphasise renal or generic smooth muscle regulation.

name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands
rationale: Members share cysteine palmitoylation/lipidation enabling Wnt and Hedgehog ligand secretion (PORCN, HHAT), distinct from confusables on prenylation, Hh autoprocessing or downstream signaling.

qualifier: bile acid, bilirubin and drug transport
name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and xenobiotic transport
rationale: Members span bile acid synthesis and transport, bilirubin glucuronidation, SLCO/ABC drug transport and their defects, unlike confusables on phase I xenobiotic oxidation or lipoprotein assembly.

name: Recombinational DNA repair via strand invasion and synthesis
rationale: Members concern homologous recombination steps (strand invasion, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, repair synthesis, cross-link repair), unlike confusables on NHEJ, damage sensing or BRCA defects.

name: Iron and oligopeptide transport at host-pathogen interface
rationale: Members combine iron import/homeostasis, proton-oligopeptide and vacuolar transport with neutrophil antimicrobial granules and pathogen nutrient competition, which the heme/transferrin confusables lack.

qualifier: C-strand replication, capping and recombination control
name: Telomere C-strand replication, capping and recombination control
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis, semi-conservative replication, t-loop/D-loop handling and end protection, lacking the confusables' telomerase extension or general DNA topology.

qualifier: enterohepatic recycling and nuclear receptor feedback
name: Bile acid recycling and nuclear receptor feedback
rationale: Members concern bile acid transport, recycling, signaling and LXR-regulated feedback on synthesis, whereas confusables cover bile acid biosynthetic routes or intestinal lipid absorption.

qualifier: AP-1 and NR4A in inflammatory and growth signaling
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to inflammatory and growth signals
rationale: Members share AP-1/FOS and NR4A immediate-early gene induction downstream of TNF, KRAS and chemokine signaling, unlike confusables on UV/stress responses, mRNA decay or MAPK feedback.

qualifier: orexin-linked sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
name: Orexin-regulated sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
rationale: Members cover sleep/wake and feeding behaviour with orexin/neuropeptide FF receptor signaling, distinct from confusables on stress-axis hormones, appetite hormones or opioid/social behaviour.

core: Smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
name: cGMP-regulated smooth muscle tone, blood pressure and natriuresis
rationale: Members share smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, cGMP synthesis and guanylyl cyclase signaling with renal sodium/urine output, lacking confusables' eNOS activation or renin-angiotensin control.

name: Epidermal lipoxygenase hepoxilin and fatty acid metabolism
rationale: Members share 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin/12-HETE synthesis and fatty acid metabolism linked to ichthyosis genes, distinct from confusables on cornification, lipoxins or P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylation.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitoribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern methylation and pseudouridylation of rRNA, tRNA and mRNA, especially mitochondrial RNA processing and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation or nuclear tRNA processing.

name: Nitrogen-starvation microautophagy and ATG8 delipidation
rationale: The three members tie nitrogen-level sensing to nuclear microautophagy and autophagy-protein delipidation, distinct from confusables on autophagosome-lysosome fusion or protein prenylation.

qualifier: phase-specific ion channels and conduction-system depolarization
name: Cardiac action potential ion channels and conduction-system depolarization
rationale: Members span action potential phases 0-4, K+/HCN/Na+ channels and SA/AV/Purkinje depolarization, beyond the confusables' gap-junction coupling or calcium-channel regulation.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and LXR triglyceride regulation
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL remodeling and clearance, lipase assembly and LXR-driven lipogenesis/lipolysis, unlike confusables on intestinal absorption or HDL/LDL remodeling.

name: Copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: All members concern copper or manganese import, detoxification and homeostasis, while confusables address zinc, iron/heme or metallothionein responses.

name: Osmoregulation and renal salt-water reabsorption via vasopressin
rationale: Members span osmotic stress responses, Na+/K+/Mg2+/Cl- homeostasis, SLC12 cotransporters, aquaporins and vasopressin signaling, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin, neuronal K+ channels or urea/glycerol transport.

qualifier: notochord, floor plate and neural plate
name: Notochord, floor plate and early neural plate development
rationale: Members concern axial mesoderm/notochord, ventral midline floor plate and neural fold/plate patterning, distinct from confusables on left-right asymmetry, neural plate border or spinal cord neuron specification.
